lesson.text: Quick memory: what does a map's key tell you? (What each symbol means.) Most maps also have a north arrow. Today: the compass and its directions.
A compass shows four main directions: north, east, south and west. Going clockwise, they always come in this order. A saying to remember it: Naughty Elephants Squirt Water.
Between them are four more: north-east, south-east, south-west and north-west. That makes eight points. North-east is halfway between north and east.
A compass needle is a tiny magnet. Wherever you stand, it swings round to point north, so explorers like Zara can always find their way.
The Sun helps too: it rises in the east and sets in the west. On most maps north is at the top, so east is on the right and west is on the left.
Turning: a quarter turn clockwise from north faces east; a half turn faces south. An eighth of a turn moves one point on the eight-point compass, from north to north-east.
To give directions, say which way and how far: walk 3 squares north, then 2 squares east. Always start from where you are!
Try it in the world: build a giant compass on the ground with blocks, a red block for north and the seven other points around it. Then give a friend directions to a treasure chest.

exercises.prompt: Put the four main compass points in order, going clockwise from north.
exercises.explain: Clockwise from north: north, east, south, west.

exercises.hint: Opposite means a half turn away.
exercises.explain: South is opposite north; east is opposite west.

exercises.prompt: On most maps, north is at the top.
exercises.hint: Look for the north arrow on a map.
exercises.explain: True: most maps put north at the top, so east is on the right.

exercises.hint: It sets in the west. Where is opposite west?
exercises.explain: The Sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

exercises.prompt: The Sun sets in the west.
exercises.hint: Morning Sun comes from one side, evening Sun from the opposite side.
exercises.explain: True: it rises in the east and sets in the west.

exercises.prompt: Which direction is halfway between north and east?
exercises.hint: Put the two names together, north first.
exercises.explain: Halfway between north and east is north-east.

exercises.prompt: What makes a compass needle point north?
exercises.hint: Remember what the needle is made of.
choices: it is heavier at one end
exercises.explain: The needle is a tiny magnet, and Earth's magnetism turns it to point north.

exercises.prompt: If north is at the top of a map, east is on the left.
exercises.hint: Say the points clockwise from the top: north, then which way?
exercises.explain: False: going clockwise from north at the top, east is on the right.

exercises.hint: Swap each part for its opposite: south becomes north, west becomes east.
exercises.explain: Opposite south is north and opposite west is east, so north-east.

exercises.prompt: Put these in order, going clockwise from north.
exercises.hint: Between each main point comes the point that joins its two names.
exercises.explain: North, north-east, east, south-east, south, south-west (then west and north-west).

exercises.prompt: Bram faces west and makes a half turn. Which way does he face now?
exercises.hint: A half turn faces the opposite way.
exercises.explain: A half turn from west faces east, the opposite direction.

exercises.prompt: Zara walks north, then turns to walk east. Which turn did she make?
exercises.hint: Picture a clock: north is at 12. Where is east?
exercises.explain: From north to east is one step clockwise: a quarter turn clockwise.

exercises.prompt: Mimi's cake shop is south-east of the well. Which direction is the well from the shop?
exercises.hint: Going back the other way, each part of the direction swaps to its opposite.
exercises.explain: The shop is south-east of the well, so the well is north-west of the shop.

exercises.prompt: Match each direction to its opposite.
exercises.hint: Opposite means a half turn away. Swap each part of the name for its opposite.
exercises.explain: North and south, east and west, north-east and south-west, north-west and south-east are opposites.

exercises.prompt: Sort the directions: a main point, or one in between?
exercises.hint: The main points are one word; the in-between points join two of them.
exercises.explain: Main points: north, west and east (and south). In between: south-east, north-west and south-west, each halfway between two main points.

exercises.prompt: Zara faces north. Match each turn to the way she faces after it.
items: an eighth of a turn clockwise
exercises.hint: A quarter turn moves one main point; an eighth moves one of the eight points.
exercises.explain: A quarter turn clockwise: east. A half turn: south. Three quarter turns clockwise: west. An eighth of a turn clockwise: north-east.
